text: Bill Davis has, for about 60 years, run a program for kids up to grade 6, in the Summerhill and Cottingham area, simply to allow these kids to come together and play. The parents of current and past kids who attended the program, are requesting that Bill Davis be meaningfully recognized by the City for his long-term initiative to bring play, laughter, a sense of belonging and very happy memories to many hundreds of kids in a safe and fun environment. William (Bill) R. Davis was born in Toronto and has lived his whole life in the Yonge and Summerhill area. He is married to Velma and they have 3 daughters. Bill was a Chartered Accountant and worked for most of his career with the United Church and Canada. Bill is currently in his 80s. City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation to investigate the feasibility of naming the playground in Lionel Conacher Park to "Bill Davis Playground" and to report back to the Toronto and East York Community Council with a recommendation based on the criteria and process outlined in the Property Naming Policy.
